automatic_dagger_recording.start_recording: original FA-confirmed ready point with the preceding one second of real camera/follower samples prepended
automatic_dagger_recording.release_wait_after_arrival: max(3 seconds of continuous verified holding, live following preparation elapsed)

enabled_follower_startup.already_disabled_follower: normal startup preloads measured current pose and directly enables; no disable/reset fallback
enabled_follower_startup.mode2_transition: hold fixed measured position while retaining all six motor enables

teaching_handoff.release_requires: continuous verified hold >=3s and currently live dual six-joint FC preparation, followed by release_master
driver_checks: native actual FC priming before FA release
native FA forwarding and follower acknowledgement before ready status
teaching_handoff.failed_transition: FC then fresh enabled actual pose, hold the newly observed current pose; never pull to an old alignment target
teaching_handoff.manual_disable: immediate cancellation, latched until a new driver process
teaching_handoff.ready_requires: both fresh master mode acknowledgements and command observations after this request; idle has no periodic stream requirement
teaching_handoff.runtime_recording: bad/expired acknowledged mode pauses append without resetting buffers or moving; legal idle may record synchronized cameras/followers; unused master queues do not block synchronization
teaching_handoff.resume_failure: keep existing session and data, keep policy paused, diagnose side/mode and accept a later explicit r; fold in-progress repeated r keys
teaching_handoff.preflight: fresh follower feedback, transport and executed command acknowledgements; no ROS node-name-prefix or camera-age gate for the mechanical probe

enabled_master_startup.silent_fa_bootstrap: one FC role request, then only passive native feedback until six motors enabled and actual pose verified
enabled_master_startup.firmware_gate: identifiable cached version >=1.8.9; no live firmware query
enabled_master_startup.holding_target: fresh native actual pose once before first target write, then fixed throughout recovery
enabled_master_startup.prepared_driver_startup: passive CAN1 and six-enable verification; no repeated FC/Enable/motion writes

native_follow_before_fa.release_point: MasterSlaveConfig(FA), not a later teach command
native_follow_before_fa.before_release: forward fresh native actual FC poses and require both followers to acknowledge this priming source
native_follow_before_fa.after_release: forward complete native155/156/157/159 immediately on an independent loop
native_follow_before_fa.native_source: physical RX only; per-component kernel timestamps and handoff epochs
native_follow_before_fa.ready: native FA source published and follower command-source acknowledgement received
native_follow_before_fa.failed_entry: close forwarding; FC; verify fresh enabled actual pose; hold that new current pose
native_follow_before_fa.runtime_stream_loss: after the first complete FA group, wait in the same phase before or after acknowledgement without an FA wait deadline; no replay or mode changes
native_follow_before_fa.gripper_raw_and_command_separate: signed raw abnormal bound +/-150000um; outgoing clamp0..80000um
native_follow_before_fa.missing_data_validation: per-ID diagnostic added; complete native groups and freshness limits remain required
native_follow_before_fa.pre_ack_stream_loss_behavior: recoverable waiting in the same FA epoch without a fixed deadline; existing shutdown and cancellation remain available
native_follow_before_fa.startup_reference: original role-configuration sleep2; no equivalent original native first-group timeout; added FA2s and pair-ACK2.5s deadlines removed
native_follow_before_fa.startup_release_limit: FA already releases; waiting does not guarantee following or holding before native data arrives

mapping.left_single: d or post-save Space in confirmed teaching mode

usb_foot_pedal.gesture_clock: kernel CLOCK_MONOTONIC, preserve timestamps and sort queued events
usb_foot_pedal.input_isolation: exclusive grab on this USB device, private command/readiness pipes
usb_foot_pedal.stop_owner: signal only the owned foreground Bash group; original owner performs driver-first cleanup

inference_tail_recording.start_boundary: entering takeover at the former immediate capture-stop point
inference_tail_recording.data_source: existing live inference recorder; actual camera/follower observations

inference_exit_recording.on_exit: stop and join capture, then save the unsaved inference segment and camera videos
inference_exit_recording.stop_owner_order: stop managed arm drivers before signalling the collector
inference_exit_recording.data_source: real captured follower and camera observations, no new policy execution
inference_exit_recording.dataset: inference_hdf5 with the next available episode index
inference_exit_recording.interrupted_writer: retain original buffers and reuse the pending output path
inference_exit_recording.second_ctrl_c: force exit; incomplete exports may remain

master_gripper_handoff.selection: unset DAGGER_TEST_MASTER_GRIPPER_RELEASE defaults to both; explicit right and empty/other legacy selections remain compatible
master_gripper_handoff.before_fa: one gripper release per selected side in WIDTH mode at its own existing prepared native actual width, after original FA phase arming and before its role request
master_gripper_handoff.fa_requires: unchanged existing follower and native 155/156/157/159 checks

save_follower_pause.pause_before: capture stop, export and save confirmation, including empty save requests
save_follower_pause.control_channel: existing master config String topics: pause_following/resume_following
save_follower_pause.effect: pause native FA target publication on both masters; followers retain their last accepted joint and gripper targets
save_follower_pause.in_flight_commands: already dispatched targets may complete; no physical instant-stop claim
save_follower_pause.resume: only immediately before an actual post-save start_collection; Space/left pedal requests keep existing semantics

dagger_preroll.anchor: existing FA-confirmed readiness, measured with rospy.Time.now
dagger_preroll.window: [ready-1s, ready] using the original camera ROS source timestamps
dagger_preroll.sampling: independent data-only worker with non-destructive five-stream snapshots after inference capture stop/join/save
dagger_preroll.data_sources: three actual BGR camera images and both actual follower joint/gripper states
dagger_preroll.commit: stop/join worker, original start_collection, then existing add_frame in source order
dagger_preroll.pairing: existing FIRST/MID and next actual-state action pairing retained
dagger_preroll.live_handoff: skip sources already imported by this prefix
dagger_preroll.failed_or_interrupted_entry: stop/join data worker and clear its pending prefix

startup_enable.trigger: normal startup with complete normal native feedback showing disabled or partially enabled motors
startup_enable.target: one fresh actual six-joint pose preloaded before enabling and reseeded after; not zero/initial pose
startup_enable.mode: CAN1 if needed using the existing measured-pose exit-teach/position-control sequence
startup_enable.enable_command: EnableArm(7), only if motors still need enabling
startup_enable.success: actual six motor enable bits and original startup feedback verification, not a software flag or SDK return value
startup_enable.silent_fa_recovery: existing firmware-gated actual-feedback recovery; no blind enable without a native pose
